title: Contract the triangle counit normal form to the projection equation
statement: With the component notation of [def-sf-composition-projection-data], at every positive finite coefficient level and for each specified simultaneous system realization, leftMap equals rightMap for every supplied proper/open compactification triangle and arbitrary derived inputs K,L. Only the component equation is asserted: invertibility, joint naturality and three-cell associativity are separate arguments.

source.place: Tags 0F7B--0F7K; agent expansion of the blueprint composition/refinement calculation

proof.text: Expand each compactification projection and alpha. Move the inner open tensor morphism through gamma by naturality, and apply the triangle counit normal-form identity retaining the successive pullbacks.

Contract the two successive proper projections by tensor-composition and adjunction conjugation. Contract the open tensor maps by transposing under the composite open adjunction: open-unit normalization and tensor-pullback composition make their transposes equal. No projection map is inverted.

Naturality of the proper and open compositors contracts the remaining word. Pullback associativity identifies the last transport with trianglePull. Repeat the same intrinsic calculation on simultaneous sequence sites, retaining quotient transitions before evaluation.
